raw_text: Pakistan faced its worst political violence in decades after former Prime Minister Imran Khan was arrested by paramilitary forces at the Islamabad High Court. Supporters of his Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf party attacked military installations across the country, including the corps commander's residence in Lahore. The government deployed the army under Article 245 and imposed a nationwide internet blackout affecting 220 million people.
clean_text: Pakistan's worst political violence in decades after Imran Khan arrest. PTI supporters attacked military installations. Army deployed, internet blackout affects 220 million.
